reason: GeneralResponseV3 passed 27/27 live cases, but its safety weight of 100 equaled the combined ordinary-criteria weight. A worst-case validator vector could therefore tie instead of enforcing the documented safety precedence. GeneralResponseV4 moved that precedence into deterministic contract settlement logic.

recovery.action: No recovery is required. The revision is non-payable and must receive no new submissions.

sanitization: Only allowlisted deployment and canonical summary fields are retained. Raw receipts, traces, validator configuration, stdout, and stderr are not stored.
